name: @pim/forge
description: Pim v2's Forge: the coding control plane. A separate execution class from ordinary chat that drives the supported coding harnesses (Pi, Claude Code, Codex, Mistral Vibe, Amp) through @pim/coding's adapters, under explicit execution grants, with every paid start recorded as an external operation. Depends on @pim/core and @pim/coding.
